import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pandas.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pandas.DataFrame]:
    inbound = inputs["inbound"]
    target_snapshot = inputs["target_snapshot"]

    # Step 1: build STG_NEW
    filtered = inbound[inbound["qty"] > 0]

    stg_new = (
        filtered.groupby(["product_id", "batch_date"], as_index=False)
        .agg(
            total_qty=("qty", "sum"),
            max_unit_cost=("unit_cost", "max"),
        )
    )

    # Step 2: DELETE FROM TARGET_SNAPSHOT WHERE batch_date IN (distinct batch_dates from STG_NEW)
    arriving_dates = set(stg_new["batch_date"].unique())

    if len(target_snapshot) > 0 and arriving_dates:
        kept = target_snapshot[~target_snapshot["batch_date"].isin(arriving_dates)]
    else:
        kept = target_snapshot.copy()

    # Step 3: INSERT INTO TARGET_SNAPSHOT SELECT * FROM STG_NEW
    result = pd.concat([kept, stg_new], ignore_index=True)

    result = result[["product_id", "batch_date", "total_qty", "max_unit_cost"]]

    return {"target_snapshot": result}
